newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse share indices slip.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse share indices slip.

text.p: Share indices on Ivory Coast's stock exchange, the Bourse des Valeurs d'Abidjan (BVA), slipped slightly in the week to Friday, its market report showed.
Dealers said sellers predominated, possibly due to the start of the new school year.
The BVA All-Share Index shed 0.28 percent to close at 363.68 points, down from last week's 364.70 points, trimming the 1996 rise to 31.17 percent.
The "12 VB" blue chips index fell 0.16 percent to close at 246.89 points, down from 247.28 points -- a 1996 cumulative rise of 23.91 percent.
Turnover fell to 100,325,000 CFA francs from 433,314,000 CFA francs the previous week, with the number of shares traded down at 5,390 compared to 15,383.
Dealers said the difference was not significant as shares traded this week tended to have a higher unit value.
Elf Oil-CI (+1,190 to 22,090 CFA francs) was the main riser, hardware retailer Bernabe (-1,350 to 14,600 CFA francs) was the main faller.
